messages:
maria: FYI found a reproducible dup in staging: socket reconnect + snapshot rollback -> downstream executed same fragment twice. attached small repro.
josh: ack, can you paste a tiny log snippet?
maria: 
```
15:02:03 conn=42 attach lease=11 snap=abc
15:02:05 rollback seq=12
15:02:05 client reconnect lease=12 resume=rt-87a
15:02:05 forward ds-id=ds-9f
15:02:06 forward ds-id=ds-9f  <-- duplicate
```
li: looks like resume re-sent an in-flight fragment. we don't add any idemp header today.
anita: options: (A) edge adds X-Edge-Idempotency per-request (low friction), (B) fragment marker store with TTL (stronger), (C) change rollback to wait for ack (bad perf).
kevin: agree (A) short-term, (B) RFC medium-term. note perf: marker store adds p99 write unless async/batched.
josh: action: add header PR for eng-runtime, ops add a staging harness to assert no duplicate calls, and open RFC for marker store with cost model.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled to staging: edge-runtime/idempotency-header @ 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z
maria: created GH issue #1422 with repro and logs. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
